title: ケープ・ジョーンズ・ダンス (Cape Jones Dance)
kind: anime-intro song for the Cape Jones dance scene
built_from: Tamagotchi loop (music-pullin proof-track) extended to full song; FluidR3_GM + FluidSynth render chain
master_chain: repo pedalboard_master.py (HP30 -> comp -18dB 2:1 10/120ms -> limiter) then loudnorm verify/trim to -14 LUFS, TP -1.0
vocal_chain: digital_fairy_chain Avanna bus (HPF150, presence +3@3k, comp 3:1, limiter -1) -> build_vocal_mix_v19 ffmpeg stack (mud -5@300, +6@3k/5k/8k, shelf +4@12k, deesser, comp 4:1) + bit-crush parallel (acrusher 10-bit mix .2) + slapback/echo wet; layers: harmony x0.5 (human bus), octave HP250+chorus x0.35 (chorus B + outro)

tracks.name: lyrics
tracks.note: separate named track per owner order: Japanese + romaji + English, timed lines below

tracks.name: vocal-lead+layers
tracks.role: sung vocal bus (lead, harmony, octave, wet)

tracks.name: inst-lead
tracks.role: GM80 square lead; intro riff + chorus-B octave double; ducked x0.45 under vocal bars 5-42

tracks.name: inst-drums
tracks.role: GM kit; crashes at chorus heads

vocal_production_honest_note: Sung by a Japanese guide voice (espeak-ng ja+f5, ~345 Hz) transformed with the Mochiichao repo's own v19 rubberband method: per-note Rubber Band pitch placement on the written melody (hard autotune by construction) + decoupled formant lift x1.7. Avanna is an English Vocaloid voicebank; VOCALOID5 cannot run on this Linux box and no voicebank/installer/project files exist in either repo (verified by full-tree search). The real Avanna/VOCALOID5 assets wait for the owner's Windows/Mac seat; the stack + method now live in production/vocal-stack/.
